description: Wire two elements of adjacent quadrants together, or unwire them with strength "none". Only adjacent pairs carry meaning: north↔east, east↔south, south↔west, north↔west. That constraint is what makes the matrix a deployment tool — a vision reaches a KPI through an objective and an initiative, never directly.

matrix_id.description: UUID of the matrix (default: the organization default matrix)

strength.description: How strongly they are linked. "none" removes the correlation.

name: set_correlation
